It was believed that a group of young stars would spin in the same direction, but we had no evidence before this 2024 image by JWST. The multiple jets at matching angles means aligned spins.

These jets occur when an interstellar gas cloud collapses in on itself while spinning to form a star. The gas spins inwards, like a whirlpool, and some of it can either be ejected up or down perpendicular to the spin. As such, the jets can tell us what angle a star is spinning. (2/3)
